army_rules.name: For the Greater Good
army_rules.rules_text: If your Army Faction is T'AU EMPIRE, at the start of your Shooting phase you can select units from your army with this ability to become Observer units. During your Shooting phase, for each Observer unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase and is eligible to shoot (excluding FORTIFICATION and Battle-shocked units), select one enemy unit that is visible to be marked as their Spotted unit until the end of the phase. Each enemy unit can only be marked as a Spotted unit once per phase. Units from your army with the For the Greater Good ability (excluding Observer units) are Guided units while targeting one or more Spotted units. Until the end of the phase, each time a model from your army in a Guided unit makes an attack that targets a Spotted unit, improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of that attack by 1. If the Spotted unit was marked by an Observer unit that has the MARKERLIGHT keyword, that attack has the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

options.name: For the Greater Good - Guided
options.rules_text: The attacking unit is Guided and is targeting its Spotted unit: improve the Ballistic Skill of ranged attacks by 1.

options.name: For the Greater Good - Guided by Markerlight
options.rules_text: The attacking unit is Guided and is targeting a unit Spotted by a MARKERLIGHT Observer: improve Ballistic Skill by 1 and gain [IGNORES COVER].

rule.name: Patient Hunter
rule.rules_text: During the third, fourth and fifth battle rounds, ranged weapons equipped by T'AU EMPIRE models from your army have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. During the third, fourth and fifth battle rounds, while a unit is a Guided unit (see For the Greater Good), each time a ranged attack is made by a model in that unit that targets a Spotted unit, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack's Ballistic Skill characteristics and/or all modifiers to the Hit roll.

options.name: Patient Hunter - Guided
options.rules_text: Guided ranged attacks have Sustained Hits 1 and ignore negative Ballistic Skill and Hit modifiers.

enhancements.name: Exemplar Of The Kauyon
enhancements.rules_text: T'AU EMPIRE model only (excluding KROOT SHAPER models). While the bearer is leading a unit, the Patient Hunter Detachment rule applies to that unit from the second battle round onwards instead of from the third.
restrictions: T'AU EMPIRE model only (excluding KROOT SHAPER models).

enhancements.name: Precision Of The Patient Hunter
enhancements.rules_text: T'AU EMPIRE model only. Each time the bearer makes a ranged attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. From the third battle round onwards, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

options.name: Precision of the Patient Hunter - Standard
Precision of the Patient Hunter - Round 3+
options.rules_text: Add 1 to ranged Hit and Wound rolls from the third battle round onwards.

enhancements.name: Solid-Image Projection Unit
enhancements.rules_text: T'AU EMPIRE model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three T'AU EMPIRE units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Through Unity, Devastation
enhancements.rules_text: T'AU EMPIRE model only (excluding KROOT SHAPER models). While the bearer is leading a unit, each time that unit is an Observer unit, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that Guided unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability while targeting their Spotted unit.
restrictions: T'AU EMPIRE model only (excluding KROOT SHAPER models).

stratagems.name: A Tempting Trap
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. The first time you use this Stratagem, you must also select one objective marker that is not in your opponent's deployment zone; until the end of the battle, this becomes your Trap objective marker.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit within range of your Trap objective marker, add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem during the first or second battle rounds.

stratagems.name: Point-Blank Ambush
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit within 9", improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem during the first or second battle rounds.

stratagems.name: Coordinate To Engage
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has just been selected as an Observer unit (see For the Greater Good).
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets its Spotted unit, improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of that attack by 1 and, if your unit has the MARKERLIGHT keyword, that attack has the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

options.name: Coordinate to Engage - Standard
options.rules_text: Improve ranged Ballistic Skill by 1 against the Spotted unit.

options.name: Coordinate to Engage - Markerlight
options.rules_text: Improve ranged Ballistic Skill by 1 and gain Ignores Cover.

stratagems.name: Combat Embarkation
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as one of the targets of that charge, and one friendly TRANSPORT.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT if it does, your opponent can select new targets for that charge.
stratagems.restrictions: Every model in your T'AU EMPIRE INFANTRY unit must be within 3" of that TRANSPORT and there must be sufficient transport capacity to embark the entire unit.

stratagems.name: Photon Grenades
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its charge target.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE GRENADES unit from your army that was selected as one of the targets of that charge.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit must immediately take a Battle-shock test, and until the end of the phase, subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that enemy unit.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot target a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.name: Wall Of Mirrors
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One STEALTH, GHOSTKEEL or COMMANDER SHADOWSUN unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot target a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

rule.name: Killing Blow
rule.rules_text: During the first, second and third battle rounds, ranged weapons equipped by T'AU EMPIRE models from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability. During the first, second and third battle rounds, while a unit is a Guided unit, its ranged weapons have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

options.name: Killing Blow - Guided
options.rules_text: Guided ranged weapons have Assault and Lethal Hits.

enhancements.name: Coordinated Exploitation
enhancements.rules_text: T'AU EMPIRE model only (excluding KROOT SHAPER models). While the bearer is leading a unit, each time that unit is an Observer unit, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in a Guided unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting their Spotted unit.
restrictions: T'AU EMPIRE model only (excluding KROOT SHAPER models).

enhancements.name: Exemplar Of The Mont'Ka
enhancements.rules_text: T'AU EMPIRE model only (excluding KROOT SHAPER models). While the bearer is leading a unit, the Killing Blow Detachment rule applies to that unit during the fourth battle round as well.
restrictions: T'AU EMPIRE model only (excluding KROOT SHAPER models).

enhancements.name: Strategic Conqueror
enhancements.rules_text: T'AU EMPIRE model only. At the start of the first battle round, before the first turn begins, select one objective marker on the battlefield. While a friendly T'AU EMPIRE model is within range of that objective marker and the bearer is on the battlefield, add 1 to that friendly model's Objective Control characteristic.

enhancements.name: Strike Swiftly
enhancements.rules_text: T'AU EMPIRE model only. In the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, you can select up to two friendly T'AU EMPIRE units within 6" of this model that do not have the Scouts ability. Until the end of the battle, all models in the selected units have the Scouts 6" ability.

stratagems.name: Pinpoint Counter-Offensive
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit (excluding KROOT units) from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a T'AU EMPIRE unit (excluding KROOT units) from your army makes an attack that targets the enemy unit that just destroyed your unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Aggressive Mobility
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

stratagems.name: Focused Fire
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: Two T'AU EMPIRE units from your army that have not been selected to shoot this phase, and one enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in either of your units makes an attack, it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target for that attack), and when resolving that attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic by 1.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem during the fourth or fifth battle rounds.

stratagems.name: Combat Debarkation
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE INFANTRY unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets the closest enemy unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Pulse Onslaught
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE INFANTRY unit (excluding KROOT units) from your army that has just shot, and one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) hit by one or more of those attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of your opponent's next turn, that enemy unit is shaken. While a unit is shaken, subtract 2 from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Advance and Charge rolls made for it.

stratagems.name: Counterfire Defence Systems
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

rule.name: Bonded Heroes
rule.rules_text: Each time a T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT model from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a unit within 12", improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 1. If that attack targets a unit within 8", improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1 as well.

options.name: Bonded Heroes - Within 12
options.rules_text: Battlesuit ranged attacks gain +1 Strength within 12 inches.

options.name: Bonded Heroes - Within 8
options.rules_text: Battlesuit ranged attacks gain +1 Strength and +1 AP within 8 inches.

enhancements.name: Internal Grenade Racks
enhancements.rules_text: T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT model only. The bearer has the GRENADES keyword, and each time the bearer ends a Normal move, you can select one enemy unit that it moved over during that move. If you do, roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

enhancements.name: Prototype Weapon System
enhancements.rules_text: T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT model only. Each time the bearer is selected to shoot, select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until those attacks are resolved, ranged weapons equipped by the bearer have the selected ability.

options.name: Prototype Weapon System - Lethal Hits
options.rules_text: Selected ranged weapons gain Lethal Hits.

options.name: Prototype Weapon System - Sustained Hits 1
options.rules_text: Selected ranged weapons gain Sustained Hits 1.

enhancements.name: Puretide Engram Neurochip
enhancements.rules_text: T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT model only. Each time you target the bearer's unit with a Stratagem, roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Starflare Ignition System
enhancements.rules_text: T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT model only. At the end of your opponent's turn, if the bearer's unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove that unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Fail-Safe Detonator
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT model from your army is destroyed.
stratagems.target: That destroyed model's unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even if that unit was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Before removing your model from play, if it has the Deadly Demise ability, do not roll for that ability; instead, you can choose whether the result of that roll is a 1 or a 6. If your model does not have the Deadly Demise ability, roll one D6 for each unit within 6" of it: on a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Stimm Injectors
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.

stratagems.name: The Shortened Blade
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models.
stratagems.restrictions: A unit targeted by this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.

stratagems.name: The Arro'Kon Protocol
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that contains 6 or more models, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. If that attack targets an enemy unit that contains 11 or more models, it has the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability instead.

options.name: The Arro'kon Protocol - 6-10 Models
options.rules_text: Ranged attacks gain Sustained Hits 1 against a unit containing 6-10 models.

options.name: The Arro'kon Protocol - 11+ Models
options.rules_text: Ranged attacks gain Sustained Hits 2 against a unit containing 11 or more models.

stratagems.name: The Torchstar Gambit
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT unit from your army that can FLY whose attacks have been resolved this phase.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move. If it does, your unit cannot declare a charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Grav-Inhibitor Field
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit must immediately take a Battle-shock test and you must roll one D6 for each model in that enemy unit: for each 6, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

rule.name: Hunter Instincts
rule.rules_text: Each time a KROOT model from your army makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll if the target of that attack is below its Starting Strength, and add 1 to the Wound roll as well if the target of that attack is Below Half-strength.

additional_rules.name: Skirmish Fighters
additional_rules.rules_text: KROOT models from your army have a 6+ invulnerable save against melee attacks and a 5+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

keywords.name: Battleline
keywords.rules_text: If you select this Detachment, KROOT CARNIVORE units from your army have the BATTLELINE keyword.

enhancements.name: Borthrod Gland
enhancements.rules_text: Kroot Flesh Shaper only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

enhancements.name: KROOTHawk FLOCK
enhancements.rules_text: KROOT model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" horizontally of the bearer.

enhancements.name: Nomadic Hunter
enhancements.rules_text: KROOT TRAIL SHAPER model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit and ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

enhancements.name: Root-Carved Weapons
enhancements.rules_text: Kroot War Shaper model only. All weapons equipped by the bearer have the [PRECISION] and [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] abilities.

stratagems.name: Join The Hunt
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One KROOT INFANTRY or KROOT HOUNDS unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength.
stratagems.restrictions: This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed CHARACTER units to Attached units. You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.

stratagems.name: A Trap Well Laid
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One KROOT unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: After your unit has resolved its attacks this phase, select one enemy unit that was hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time a KROOT model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, unless the attacking unit is Battle-shocked, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Emp Grenades
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy VEHICLE unit is selected to shoot or fight.
stratagems.target: One KROOT GRENADES unit from your army within 8" of that enemy VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, worsen the Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill characteristics of that enemy VEHICLE unit's weapons by 1.

stratagems.name: The Grisly Feast
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One KROOT unit from your army that destroyed one or more enemy units this phase.
stratagems.effect: In your opponent's next Command phase, each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test. If the unit taking that test is Below Half-strength, subtract 1 from that test. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

stratagems.name: Guerrilla Warriors
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a KROOT unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That KROOT unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Hidden Hunters
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One KROOT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

rule.name: Expert Fieldcraft
rule.rules_text: In your Shooting phase, when a friendly PATHFINDER TEAM/STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit is selected to shoot, those ranged attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.

enhancements.name: Negation Emitters
enhancements.rules_text: STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit only. This unit has -3" detection range.

enhancements.name: Unmasking Suite
enhancements.rules_text: GHOSTKEEL BATTLESUIT/PATHFINDER TEAM/STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit only. When this unit is selected to shoot, you can select one enemy unit within 24" of this unit. That enemy unit has +3" detection range until this unit has shot.
restrictions: GHOSTKEEL BATTLESUIT/PATHFINDER TEAM/STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit only.

stratagems.name: Marker Beacon
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly PATHFINDER TEAM/STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: Microdrone Support
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PATHFINDER TEAM/STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit starts an action.
stratagems.target: That PATHFINDER TEAM/STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit.
stratagems.effect: That action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

stratagems.name: Autoreactive Camouflage
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly PATHFINDER TEAM/STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit, if that friendly unit is hidden.
stratagems.target: That PATHFINDER TEAM/STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +1 Sv.

detachments.name: Auxiliary Cadre

rule.name: Integrated Command Structure
rule.rules_text: Friendly KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS units have the following ability: Harnessed Alien Instincts: In your Shooting phase, this unit can select one visible enemy unit within 12". That enemy unit is prey-marked.

additional_rules.name: Harnessed Alien Instincts
additional_rules.rules_text: While a unit is prey-marked, that unit has +3" detection range.

additional_rules.name: Localised Stealth Projectors (Aura)
additional_rules.rules_text: Friendly GHOSTKEEL BATTLESUIT/STEALTH BATTLESUITS units have the following ability: When a friendly KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS unit within 6" of this unit has shot, those attacks do not prevent that unit from being hidden.

restrictions: This detachment has the AUXILIARIES tag and cannot be taken with another AUXILIARIES detachment.

enhancements.name: Student of Kauyon
enhancements.rules_text: KROOT SHAPER model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select up to three friendly KROOT CARNIVORES/FARSTALKERS units. Those units have Deep Strike.

enhancements.name: Admired Leader
enhancements.rules_text: T'AU EMPIRE model only (excluding KROOT models). In your Command phase, you can select one KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS unit within 12" of this model. If you do, that unit has +1 Ld and OC until the start of your next Command phase.
restrictions: T'AU EMPIRE model only (excluding KROOT models).

stratagems.name: Experimental Modifications
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.target: That KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's attacks have +1 AP.

stratagems.name: Alien Expertise
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS unit is selected to make an advance move.
stratagems.target: That KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Guided by Unity
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly T'AU EMPIRE unit (excluding KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS units) is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That T'AU EMPIRE unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks that target a unit within 9" of a friendly KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS unit have [LETHAL HITS].

detachments.name: Experimental Prototype Cadre

rule.name: Superior Craftsmanship
rule.rules_text: Friendly BATTLESUIT CHARACTER units' ranged attacks have +6" R.

restrictions: This detachment has the BATTLESUIT tag and cannot be taken with another BATTLESUIT detachment.

enhancements.name: Thermoneutronic Projector
enhancements.rules_text: BATTLESUIT model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, select one of this model's T'au Flamer weapons. That weapon's attacks have +2 S and +1 AP and D.

enhancements.name: Plasma Accelerator Rifle
enhancements.rules_text: BATTLESUIT model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, select one of this model's Plasma Rifle weapons. That weapon's attacks have +2 S and +1 A, AP and D.

enhancements.name: Supernova Launcher
enhancements.rules_text: BATTLESUIT model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, select one of this model's Airbursting Fragmentation Projector weapons. That weapon's attacks have +3 S and +1 AP and D.

stratagems.name: Experimental Ammunition
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly BATTLESUIT CHARACTER unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That BATTLESUIT CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks have +1 S, -1 D, +1 S, AP and [HAZARDOUS].

shared_wargear.name: Guardian Drone
shared_wargear.rules_text: Each time a model makes a ranged attack that targets the bearer's unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

shared_wargear.name: Gun Drone
shared_wargear.rules_text: The bearer is equipped with a twin pulse carbine.

shared_wargear.name: Marker Drone
shared_wargear.rules_text: The bearer's unit has the MARKERLIGHT keyword and can act as an Observer unit for another unit even if it Advanced this turn.

shared_wargear.name: Missile Drone
shared_wargear.rules_text: The bearer is equipped with a missile pod.

shared_wargear.name: Shield Drone
shared_wargear.rules_text: Add 1 to the bearer's Wounds characteristic.

units.name: Cadre Fireblade

abilities.name: Core
abilities.rules_text: Leader

abilities.name: Volley Fire
abilities.rules_text: While this model is leading a unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit.

abilities.name: Crack Shot
abilities.rules_text: Each time this model makes a ranged attack, on a Critical Wound, that attack has an Armour Penetration characteristic of -3.

wargear_options: This model can be equipped with up to two of the following, and can take duplicates: 1 gun drone, 1 marker drone, 1 shield drone.

abilities.name: Core
abilities.rules_text: Deep Strike

abilities.name: Core
abilities.rules_text: Leader

abilities.name: Way of the Short Blade
abilities.rules_text: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within 9 inches, add 1 to the Wound roll.

abilities.name: Puretide’s Teachings
abilities.rules_text: Once per battle round, you can target this model’s unit with a Stratagem. If you do, reduce the CP cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.

units.name: Commander in Coldstar Battlesuit

abilities.name: Core
abilities.rules_text: Deep Strike

abilities.name: Core
abilities.rules_text: Leader

abilities.name: Coldstar Commander
abilities.rules_text: While this model is leading a unit, models in that unit have a Move characteristic of 12 inches and ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the ASSAULT ability.

abilities.name: Battlesuit Support System
abilities.rules_text: The bearer’s unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back, but when doing so only models equipped with this wargear can make ranged attacks.

abilities.name: Shield Generator
abilities.rules_text: The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save.

abilities.name: Weapon Support System
